skill_outcomes.outcome_description: State basic concepts about system of linear equations.
Describe basic concepts about matrix and determinants; list properties of matrix operations and determinant properties.
Explain basic concepts about vector and vector space.
Describe the concept of linear transformation and summarize its properties; describe the method of diagonalizing matrices.
Solve systems of linear equations using various methods such as Gaussian elimination, Gauss-Jordan elimination, matrix method, and determinant method.
Solve problems related to matrix operations such as finding matrix sum, product, rank, inverse, and determinant.

Solve problems related to vector space such as proving a set is a subspace, finding basis and dimension of a vector space, determining linear independence or dependence of a set of vectors, proving a set of vectors is a basis of a vector space.
Identify linear transformations and solve problems related to finding matrix representation of linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrices, and diagonalizing matrices.
Explain basic economic concepts such as supply function, demand function, market equilibrium.

Apply knowledge and skills about systems of equations, matrices, and determinants to establish and solve models of single commodity market equilibrium, multiple commodity markets, macroeconomic equilibrium model, input-output balance model, network analysis, text encoding, Markov chains.
Develop the ability to take personal responsibility and partial responsibility for the group.
Develop the ability to learn independently, conduct independent research, work collaboratively.
